source: tests/acceptance/gl21.md#gl21.wsi-configs; survey of the window-system sources, 2026-11-03 (Xorg 21.1.7 glx/, Mesa 26.2.4 src/glx, src/egl, src/loader, the DRI frontend)

cases.criteria: eglChooseConfig(RGBA8888, DEPTH 24, STENCIL 8, WINDOW|PBUFFER) returns a config and dEQP picks rgba8888d24s8ms0; needs Z24_UNORM_S8_UINT; internal device run 016 found none
EGL on X11 in a depth-16 session offers an RGB565 window config with depth 16
eglChooseConfig(EGL_SAMPLES 4, EGL_WINDOW_BIT) returns a config exactly when the 4-sample GLX visual renders (one driver list)
eglInitialize on the X11 platform uses DRI3, GL_RENDERER is poulsback, GL_VERSION has Mesa 26.2.4 and the run dir libraries are mapped
Every EGL config is one of the driver formats and its EGL_NATIVE_VISUAL_ID is a core X visual of matching depth
A d24s8 double-buffered visual exists and a stencil-masked draw reads back as expected; needs Z24_UNORM_S8_UINT
In a DefaultDepth 16 session a depth-16 visual is direct and a clear to red reads 0xF800; needs RGB565 in the kernel, DDX and driver
In the depth-16 session a 565 visual with depth 16 resolves a depth test; needs Z16 or mixed_color_depth_bits
glXChooseFBConfig(SAMPLE_BUFFERS 1, SAMPLES 4, WINDOW, DOUBLEBUFFER) gives a config, GL_SAMPLES is 4 and edge pixels of a swapped triangle are resolved
No client fbconfig or EGL config claims samples the driver does not render
glXIsDirect, GL_RENDERER poulsback, GL_VERSION with Mesa 26.2.4 and GLX_RENDERER_ACCELERATED_MESA 1 on every offered visual; the suites use it as a precheck
The Xorg log shows the DRISWRAST provider (no DRI2 in the DDX) and no "no usable GL providers"
A raw xcb-glx probe records the server configs and finds a TrueColor depth-24 double-buffered config with depth 24, stencil 0, samples 0
Every client fbconfig is one of the driver formats and appears in the raw server list
glXChooseVisual(RGBA, DOUBLEBUFFER, DEPTH 24) returns a visual that renders a clear read back by XGetImage, direct
A direct context on the root visual renders; today the server root config is d24s8, so this waits for Z24_UNORM_S8_UINT
A depth-32 GLX visual takes a direct context and alpha 0x80 reads back from the window pixmap with Composite on
The client fbconfig and visual counts equal the recorded baseline (a Debian Mesa change can drop the server MSAA configs)
In the depth-24 session no depth-16 GLX visual is listed and the server 565 configs have no GLX_WINDOW_BIT (the server rule, recorded)
The raw server list has a TrueColor depth-24 window config with 4 samples
